details.name: Antal
details.quote: Antal of Op Z7 reporting for duty. I've studied Originium automation and occasionally help with modifying or repairing Originium devices. You may approach me for such tasks... And I have a question for you. What is the material of your mask? Carbon fiber?
details.infection: Oripathy negative, based on medical examination reports.
details.exp1d: Tool Assembly: Device Kitbashing Show Antal a device for the first time, and he'll quickly come up with a dozen plans to disassemble and modify it.
details.exp2d: Situational Analysis: Puzzle-Solving Hardly any riddles can beat Antal. But riddles and puzzles on the newspaper are another thing.
details.hb1d: Mind Honing: Gameplay Analyst Antal never cared about winning or losing, but he always ends up winning.
details.hb2d: Creative: Humor Sensitivity Training Antal believes that constant practice will make him the Master Guru of Lame Jokes.
